pack: the e-dense pipeline's pack output directory

provenance.what: Inkling-2-Small non-expert linears (attention q/k/v/r/gate/o, router, LM head rows [0,200192)) as EXL3 6-bit mul1 trellises, for the kortexa-ai EXL3 2.59bpw expert export (e-dense, prefill lane phase 5)

hessians.how: tf-inkling2-run --hcap (hcap.zig): H = sum over rows of x^T x (cuBLASLt bf16 operands, fp32 sums) of each dense linear's input, during the prefill of every calibration row from position 0 in 1024-row chunks, on the kortexa EXL3 store at TP2 (the EXL3 deployment's knobs TF_INKLING2_EXL3_PROMPT=g2k8s2 TF_INKLING2_PREFILL_ATTN=tc, activations native)
hessians.view: the EXL3 view (symlinks into the export)
